name: Kiteboarding Barbados
summary: Kiteboarding Barbados teaches kitesurfing on the south coast, with instructors from Barbados, at Silver Point or Long Beach depending on the wind. Lessons start at two hours, with all gear provided. They also teach surfing and rent surfboards and stand up paddleboards.
standouts: Instructors from Barbados who know the local beaches
All kitesurfing gear provided, including lifejacket and helmet

trips.title: Kiteboarding Lessons
trips.summary: Kitesurfing lessons at Silver Point or Long Beach on the south coast, with the beach chosen by the wind on the day. You learn to set up and steer the kite, launch and land it safely, self rescue, body drag and get up on the board. The school says most learners need three to five two hour lessons to get up and riding.
highlights: Peak kite season December to July
Wind usually 12 to 25 knots at peak times
trips.departsFrom: Silver Point or Long Beach, depending on wind direction

trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only: booked through a lesson request form on this page (no payment or instant confirmation), phone/WhatsApp or email. Rates are per hour with equipment included; groups larger than 2 must contact for rates. FAQ says group classes are 3 hours per lesson with three students per instructor, no price shown. Home page says classes run every day starting at 8:00 a.m., but the FAQ says kite lessons run between 9am and 3pm subject to weather, so no departure times recorded. FAQ: no wind means no lesson, and you pay only for lessons taken. Lesson page names the spots Silver Rock and Long Beach; FAQ names them Silver Point and Long Beach Bay. priceFrom is the lowest hourly rate.

trips.title: Surf Board Classes
trips.summary: Surf lessons for adults and children with local instructors, starting at one hour. The school works from south coast beaches including Long Beach, Silver Point and Freights.
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only: the page says contact us to book. Home page says surfing classes run every day starting at 8:00 a.m. Beach for surf classes not stated; the home page lists Long Beach, Silver Point and Freights among the beaches the instructors use.

trips.summary: Stand up paddleboards for hire for two hours, a day or a week, with the option of an instructor.
highlights: Hire for 2 hours, 1 day or 1 week
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only: the page says contact us. The 2 hour price carries the footnote '* US$15 with instructor', which is unclear (an add-on or a different rate); check with the operator. Home page says a 1 hr SUP rental is available, but the price table shows N/A for 1 hour.
